boards.title: Everyday devices
boards.subtitle: Open, browse rooms, search, start without an account

screens.title: All devices
screens.description: HomeVerb header with search and plus icons. Room chips All (selected), Living Room, Bedroom, Bathroom; small manage icon. Two-column four-card grid: Bedroom AC / Cooling / 24 C / On; Floor lamp / 65% / On; Living room TV / Off; Air sensor / 22 C / 46%. Small freshness line Updated just now; subtle Refresh action. Separate teal quick power targets on writable cards, sensor has none. Bottom nav Devices (selected), Platforms, Settings. No profile avatar.

screens.title: Room filter
screens.description: Same device home; Living Room chip selected. Only Floor lamp and Living room TV cards, room-specific pin ordering. Subtle count 2 devices and empty breathing space. Plus and room management available. Bottom navigation unchanged.

screens.title: Find a device
screens.description: Search screen with back, focused search field containing lamp and clear icon. One matching card Floor lamp with room Living Room and state On. Recent searches AC and TV, unobtrusive. No fake keyboard occupying the screen. Search is local and has Cancel.

screens.title: First launch
screens.description: HomeVerb header and three-tab navigation. Calm outlined house/device illustration, title Your home, together. Text Add a platform to find your appliances. Primary Add Platform and secondary Receive Authorization. Small text No HomeVerb account needed. No sign-in form, carousel, avatar or marketing hero.

boards.title: Make room for your home
boards.subtitle: Create, organize, move and safely delete rooms

screens.title: Room management
screens.description: Back header Rooms with plus icon. Reorderable list Living Room / 2 devices, Primary Bedroom / 2 devices, Bathroom / 1 device, Study / 0 devices. Each row has drag handle and overflow. Unassigned / 1 device below separated without delete. Hint Drag to reorder.

screens.title: Create a room
screens.description: Room management dimmed behind a rounded bottom sheet Add Room. Labeled Room name field containing Kitchen, optional suggested chips Balcony, Nursery. Primary Save Room, secondary Cancel. No mandatory preset list.

screens.title: Move devices
screens.description: Back header Move to Room. Two selected devices Bedroom AC and Air sensor. Radio options Living Room, Primary Bedroom (selected), Bathroom, Study, Unassigned; Add Room link. Primary Move 2 Devices at bottom. Show organization only, no permission scope controls.

screens.title: Delete a room
screens.description: Rooms dimmed behind centered confirmation Delete Study? Text Devices move to Unassigned. No devices or platform accounts are deleted. Buttons Cancel and Delete Room, destructive muted red. No scary full-screen warning.

boards.title: A place for every device
boards.subtitle: Card actions, local details and connection choices

screens.title: Card actions
screens.description: Device home dimmed behind bottom sheet Floor lamp. Menu Rename, Move to Room, Pin to Top, Reorder Devices, Device Information. Clear icons, drag handle, close. No Delete Platform or credential controls.

screens.title: Device information
screens.description: Back header Device Information. Simple lamp icon; Floor lamp. Grouped rows Name / Floor lamp, Room / Living Room, Platform / Example Home, Model / Demo Light, Connection / Auto. Supported capabilities Power, Brightness, Color temperature. Local name and room have chevrons, no exposed serials or live network identifiers.

screens.title: Rename a device
screens.description: Device Information dimmed with bottom sheet Rename Device. Editable field Floor lamp, helper This name is saved on this device. Primary Save Name, Cancel. Small muted text Device access stays the same.

screens.title: Connection choice
screens.description: Back header Connection. Radio list Auto (selected) / Prefer local when available; Local network only / No cloud fallback; Platform cloud / Requires internet. Connection support applies to this device. Primary Save Preference. Keep user-facing text, no protocol jargon.

boards.title: Comfort, clearly controlled
boards.subtitle: Adjust the target without confusing it with observed state

screens.title: Climate control
screens.description: Back header Bedroom AC, info icon. Primary Bedroom subtitle. Large airy central 24 C target with minus and plus, teal arc; smaller Room 26 C / Updated just now. Power switch On. Rows Mode / Cool and Fan / Auto and Refresh State. No universal min/max text. Main focal area large and clean.

screens.title: Choose a mode
screens.description: Same climate screen dimmed with Choose Mode bottom sheet. Radio options Cool (selected), Heat, Dry, Fan only; Save Mode button. Only device-supported options. Keep currently observed temperature visible behind sheet.

screens.title: Accepted, awaiting state
screens.description: Climate screen observed target 24 C remains visible. Distinct small pending card Requested 23 C with spinner and status Accepted; not yet confirmed. Supporting text Checking device state. Primary control temporarily subdued to prevent accidental repeated writes. No success tick yet.

screens.title: Unknown outcome
screens.description: Climate screen with observed target 24 C and Last read 2 min ago. Amber rounded status card Result unknown / The change may have happened. Primary Refresh State, secondary View Details. No Retry Command, no automatic reroute button. Calm useful tone.

boards.title: Controls that fit the appliance
boards.subtitle: Different controls, one visual language

screens.title: Lighting
screens.description: Back Floor lamp. Living Room. Power On. Large simple warm lamp illustration. Brightness 65% slider and Color temperature 3000 K slider, subtle warm-to-cool track. Updated just now and Refresh. No temperature claims for all brands.

screens.title: Fan
screens.description: Back Bedroom fan. Primary Bedroom. Simple fan icon, Power On, Speed 3 stepper with device-supported marks 1 through 5. Oscillation On switch, preset Normal selection. No unrelated temperature controls.

screens.title: Media
screens.description: Back Living room TV. Large TV icon, state Paused, source HDMI 1 with selector. Accessible play/pause control, Volume 25 slider, Muted Off toggle, Power On. No streaming artwork or cloud subscriptions.

screens.title: Components and sensors
screens.description: Back Refrigerator. Two large section cards Fridge / Current 4 C / Target 4 C with stepper and Freezer / Current -18 C / Target -18 C with stepper. Secondary read-only Door / Closed. Freshness visible. Components stay within one physical device, not two separate fridge tiles.

boards.title: Know what happened
boards.subtitle: Confirm consequential actions and read honest results

screens.title: Appliance cycle
screens.description: Back Washing machine, Bathroom. Large simple washer icon. State Ready. Program selector Cotton, duration 58 min as device estimate. Primary Start Cycle. No background automation or scheduling controls.

screens.title: Confirm a cycle
screens.description: Washer screen dimmed behind clear confirmation Start Cotton cycle? Device Washing machine / Bathroom. Text The appliance continues if you close HomeVerb. Primary Start Cycle, secondary Cancel. Specific action and target, no generic confirmed checkbox.

screens.title: Verified state
screens.description: Washer device page with teal checked result State verified. Current state Running / Program Cotton / Updated 09:42. Small action View Evidence. Pause and Stop are distinct device-supported actions. No claim of guaranteed causality or exactly-once.

screens.title: Partial result
screens.description: Back Operation Results. Header 3 devices / Partially completed. Separate rows Floor lamp / Verified / On, Bedroom AC / Accepted / Waiting for state, TV / Failed / Permission denied. View Details per row and Done at bottom. No global success or Roll Back button.

boards.title: Bring appliances together
boards.subtitle: Select a path, permit local access, discover and choose

screens.title: Choose an add method
screens.description: Back Add Device. Two large concise option cards From a Platform / Choose a connected account and Nearby Devices / Discover on your local network. Link Add Another Platform. No gateway address, backend setup, or HomeVerb login.

screens.title: Local permission
screens.description: Add Device background with pre-permission panel Find devices nearby. Text Local network access lets HomeVerb discover compatible appliances while you use this screen. Primary Continue; secondary Not Now. Small system-style local network dialog preview could be avoided; only this app explanation.

screens.title: Discovering
screens.description: Back Nearby Devices. Simple teal scanning ring with device icon, Searching nearby / 6 seconds remaining. Already found Floor lamp and Living room TV appear as selectable rows; remaining scanning indicator. Cancel action visible. No endless scan or background toggle.

screens.title: Select discovered devices
screens.description: Back Found Devices. Three checkbox rows Floor lamp / Local network (selected), Living room TV / Pairing required (selected), Bedroom AC / Possible duplicate (not selected). Room dropdown Unassigned. Primary Add 2 Devices. Secondary Review Duplicate. Clear count and no automatic merging.

boards.title: Finish adding, or recover
boards.subtitle: Keep identities clear and offer one useful next step

screens.title: Resolve a possible duplicate
screens.description: Back Possible Duplicate. Two comparison cards Existing Bedroom AC and Found Bedroom AC, each with masked evidence labels Model and Connection, no raw identifiers. Text Names alone do not prove a match. Buttons Keep Separate and Confirm Same Device. No preselected merge.

screens.title: Devices added
screens.description: Back Devices Added. Teal check and title 2 devices added. Rows Floor lamp / Living Room (editable room dropdown) and TV / Living Room (editable). Primary Open Living Room, secondary Add More. Fresh state is not fabricated.

screens.title: Nothing found
screens.description: Back Nearby Devices. Minimal disconnected-device line illustration. Title No devices found. Helpful checks Same reachable network and Device is ready to pair. Primary Search Again, secondary Choose a Platform. No running spinner after timeout.

screens.title: Permission denied
screens.description: Back Nearby Devices. Restrained permission icon. Title Local access is off. Text Enable local network access in system settings to discover nearby devices. Primary Open System Settings, secondary Back. No silent switch to a cloud route.

boards.title: Connect your appliance platforms
boards.subtitle: Consumer language, multiple accounts, native authorization

screens.title: Platform accounts
screens.description: Root header Smart Appliance Platforms, plus icon. Cards Example Home / Home account / 6 devices / Checked today, Example Home / Studio account / 2 devices / Sign-in needed (amber), Example TV / Living room / 1 device / Checked yesterday. Generic letter icons. Three bottom tabs with Platforms selected. No Data Sources wording.

screens.title: Select a platform
screens.description: Back Add Platform, Search platforms field. List Example Home / Browser authorization, Example TV / Device pairing, Example Climate / Not available yet with disabled badge. Regions and compatibility details available. Tiny footer Illustrative platforms in this design, not actual compatibility claims.

screens.title: Choose region and account
screens.description: Back Connect Example Home. Region selector Europe, local Account name field Home account. Concise permission preview Read devices and Control supported appliances. Primary Continue to Authorization; Cancel. No HomeVerb signup or password field.

screens.title: Native browser consent
screens.description: System browser-style view example.invalid (fictional) and close icon. Example Home title Allow HomeVerb access? Read device state and Control supported devices listed. Masked account h***@example.invalid. Allow and Cancel. Visibly a third-party authorization page, not HomeVerb account registration.

boards.title: Authorization, step by step
boards.subtitle: Only show the flow supported by each platform

screens.title: Verification code
screens.description: Back Verify Example Home. Text Enter the code from your platform, masked destination ***42. Six clear code boxes with fictional 4 8 2 1 empty empty. Resend in 00:28. Continue disabled until complete; Cancel. No real phone number or credential.

screens.title: Approve on the appliance
screens.description: Back Pair Living room TV. Simple TV illustration displaying code 482 196 (fictional). Text Confirm this code on your TV. Waiting for approval / 01:20 remaining and Cancel. No universal QR login claim.

screens.title: Authorization expired
screens.description: Back Connect Example Home. Calm amber clock icon, Authorization expired / Start again to request a new authorization. Primary Start Again, secondary Cancel. No endless automatic login loop.

screens.title: Platform connected
screens.description: Back Platform Connected. Teal check, Example Home / Home account / Europe. Text Authorization saved securely. Primary Find Devices, secondary Done. No invented devices until discovery; no raw token display.

boards.title: Manage access deliberately
boards.subtitle: Check, reconnect, remove locally, revoke remotely

screens.title: Platform details
screens.description: Back Example Home. Home account, masked h***@example.invalid, Europe. Rows Devices / 6, Permissions / Read and control, Last checked / Today 09:40. Actions Check Connection, Reauthorize. Secondary Remove From This Device. Remote Revoke Access action distinct at bottom with provider-supported note.

screens.title: Reconnect needed
screens.description: Same account detail with amber Sign-in needed / Your platform authorization has expired. Cached device count remains labelled Last known. Primary Reauthorize. Secondary View Devices and Remove From This Device. No other account auto-selection.

screens.title: Remove local account
screens.description: Account detail dimmed, confirmation Remove from this device? Text Local authorization and associated cached data will be removed. Access on other devices is not revoked. Cancel and Remove Locally. No false global logout claim.

screens.title: Revoke provider access
screens.description: Account detail dimmed, confirmation Revoke platform access? Text Example Home supports revoking this grant. Other installations using this grant may lose access. Cancel and Revoke Access. An explicit provider action, not a local delete.

boards.title: Quiet, practical settings
boards.subtitle: Sharing is a setting, not a destination

screens.title: Settings home
screens.description: Root Settings. No avatar or profile. Groups: Home / Rooms; Authorization Sharing / Send Authorization and Receive Authorization; Preferences / Appearance, This Device, Connections; Data & Support / Recent Operations, Local Data, Diagnostics, About. Three bottom tabs, Settings selected. Spacious but all key groups visible.

screens.title: Appearance
screens.description: Back Appearance. Three visual radio options System (selected), Light, Dark with small screen swatches. Text follows system theme. Optional text-size preview normal and larger accessible text, no proprietary font selector. Save or back applies choice.

screens.title: Connection preferences
screens.description: Back Connections. Default route Auto selected, Local network only and Platform cloud options with short explanations. Local network permission / Allowed with Open Settings action. Hint A device-specific choice takes priority. No daemon, keep-alive, or background scan switch.

screens.title: Local data
screens.description: Back Local Data. Sections Device organization / Rooms and names; Cached device state / Last read snapshots; Recent operations / Latest 100 records. Clear Cached State and Clear Recent Operations distinct actions. Full Remove Local Data action at bottom, privacy note Authorizations are stored securely. No export token option.

boards.title: Send access nearby
boards.subtitle: Choose the account, verify the person, review scope

screens.title: Choose authorization
screens.description: Back Send Authorization. Eligible Home account / Example Home / Full account access selected. Studio account / Example Home / Sign-in needed disabled. Example TV / Device-bound / Cannot share disabled. Primary Find Recipient. Short permissions note Actual access depends on the platform.

screens.title: Find a recipient
screens.description: Back Select Recipient. This device / Home phone. Nearby receiver card Alex phone / Ready to receive, simple teal device icon; another Morgan tablet / Ready to receive. Select Alex phone. Small text Ask the recipient to open Receive Authorization. Scanning countdown and Cancel.

screens.title: Verify the recipient
screens.description: Back Verify Recipient. Alex phone and Home phone simple device icons linked by a line. Large pairing code 482 196. Text Compare this code on both devices. Primary Codes Match and secondary Codes Do Not Match. No credentials sent yet.

screens.title: Review before sending
screens.description: Back Review Authorization. Recipient Alex phone; Platform Example Home; Account Home account. Scope card Read and control all 6 devices. Text This grant cannot be limited to selected devices. Expiry / Set by platform. Revocation / Platform account settings. Primary Send Authorization, Cancel. No fake custom expiry or per-device restriction toggles.

boards.title: Receive and connect independently
boards.subtitle: Consent, resolve conflicts, import, then verify

screens.title: Ready to receive
screens.description: Back Receive Authorization. Large calm teal receiver ring. This device / Alex phone; Visible for 01:48. Text Keep this screen open on the same local network. Primary Stop Receiving. No always-on toggle or sharing bottom tab.

screens.title: Review incoming access
screens.description: Back Incoming Authorization. From Home phone. Pairing code 482 196, compare-code instruction. Example Home / Home account / Read and control all 6 devices. Primary Accept Authorization, secondary Decline. Clear sender, actual permissions and local secure storage statement.

screens.title: Existing account conflict
screens.description: Back Account Already Exists. Existing Home account / Example Home and incoming Home account / Example Home shown. Text Your saved authorization will not be overwritten automatically. Actions Keep Existing and Replace After Checking. No silent merge, no overwrite by default.

screens.title: Import result
screens.description: Back Authorization Received. Checklist Transferred (check), Imported securely (check), Authorization validated (check). Example Home / Home account. Text This phone now connects independently. Primary Choose Devices, secondary Done. Room assignment happens next; not a permission restriction.

boards.title: Make sharing outcomes explicit
boards.subtitle: Progress, unavailable storage, unsupported transfer, lost receipt

screens.title: Transferring
screens.description: Back Sending Authorization. Home phone to Alex phone, simple icons. Linear progress 62%, text Encrypted transfer. Stages Transfer active, Import waiting, Check waiting. Cancel Transfer button and Keep both apps open text. No credential strings or decorative charts.

screens.title: Secure storage unavailable
screens.description: Back Receive Authorization. Restrained lock icon. Title Secure storage unavailable. Text Authorization was not imported. Enable secure storage before trying again. Primary Open Settings, secondary Cancel. No Save as File or plaintext fallback.

screens.title: Cannot share this account
screens.description: Back Send Authorization. Example TV / Living room. Title This authorization cannot be shared. Text It is tied to the original device. The recipient is instructed to open Platforms and complete pairing on their own device. Primary Back to Accounts. No remote pairing, bypass or extraction action.

screens.title: Receipt not confirmed
screens.description: Back Transfer Result. Amber outlined status Unconfirmed. Text The recipient may have imported the authorization. Ask them to check their result. Timeline Sent / Import confirmation unavailable / Authorization check unavailable. Primary Done, secondary View Local Record. No Retry or automatic resend.

boards.title: Understand and recover
boards.subtitle: Useful records and diagnostics without private data

screens.title: Recent operations
screens.description: Back Recent Operations. Filter chips All, Devices, Sharing. Rows Bedroom AC / Result unknown / 09:42; Floor lamp / Verified / 09:40; TV / Failed / Permission denied; Home account sharing / Imported / 09:38. Distinct status text and subtle icon colors, chevrons for details.

screens.title: Operation evidence
screens.description: Back Operation Details. Floor lamp / Set power On. Status Verified. Requested On at 09:40:01, Observed On at 09:40:02, Source Local network. Explanation State matches the request; this alone does not prove causality. Refresh State and Done. No raw secrets or network identifiers.

screens.title: Diagnostic preview
screens.description: Back Diagnostics. Preview card App version / Design preview; Operation / Connection check; Result / Timeout; Account / Redacted; Device identifiers / Redacted. Text Review before exporting. Primary Export Redacted Report, secondary Cancel. No automatic upload or token display.

screens.title: About and compatibility
screens.description: Back About. HomeVerb wordmark, One language for your appliances. Design preview label. Rows Version, Compatibility, Privacy, Licenses. Compatibility note Support varies by platform, model and region. No claims that preview platforms are verified, no login or subscription upsell.

boards.title: Recover without repeating secrets
boards.subtitle: No peers, mismatched codes, interrupted sessions and invalid grants

screens.title: No recipient found
screens.description: Back Select Recipient. Simple two phone outline, No nearby recipients. Checks Same reachable network and Recipient opened Receive Authorization. Search ended. Primary Search Again, secondary Back. No cloud invite or persistent listener.

screens.title: Codes do not match
screens.description: Back Verification Stopped. Restrained red shield outline. Text Codes did not match. No authorization was sent. Primary Start a New Session, secondary Cancel. No Continue Anyway.

screens.title: Session stopped
screens.description: Back Sharing Session Ended. Text HomeVerb left the foreground. Nearby discovery and transfer have stopped. Additional short note If sending had started, check the recipient before sending again. Primary Done, secondary View Local Record. No automatic resume.

screens.title: Imported, needs authorization
screens.description: Back Authorization Received. Checklist Transferred (check), Imported securely (check), Authorization validation failed (amber). Text The platform requires a new sign-in. Primary Reauthorize, secondary Remove Imported Authorization. Do not show overall success or fake ready device state.

boards.title: Small details that keep it simple
boards.subtitle: Validation, empty rooms, compatibility and local data removal

screens.title: Room name validation
screens.description: Rooms dimmed under Rename Room sheet. Room name field Living Room with red underline and inline A room with this name already exists. Save disabled, Cancel available. Accessible error text, no generic crash or alert.

screens.title: An empty room
screens.description: HomeVerb device home with Study room chip selected. Quiet desk outline, No devices in Study. Primary Move Existing Devices and secondary Add Device. Bottom nav Devices, Platforms, Settings. Room management remains available.

screens.title: Platform unavailable
screens.description: Back Example Climate. Unavailable badge. Text This platform has no supported native authorization path yet. Primary Back to Platforms. Secondary Compatibility Details. No browser-secret input, backend setup or misleading Connect button.

screens.title: Clear local data confirmation
screens.description: Local Data dimmed behind confirmation Remove local data? Checklist explains Rooms, device names, snapshots and local authorizations will be removed. Other installations and platform access are not revoked. Buttons Cancel and Remove Local Data. Destructive action explicit and scoped.

boards.title: Make it feel like yours
boards.subtitle: Local identity, dark appearance, compatibility and card order

screens.title: This device
screens.description: Back This Device. Simple phone icon; editable Sharing name field Alex phone. Helper This name is shown only during nearby sharing. Primary Save Name. No registration, real person identity, phone number or cloud profile.

screens.title: Dark appearance
screens.description: HomeVerb device home in the DARK variation of the exact same design system. Charcoal-green background #14211D, cards #20332A, text #EEF5F0, teal-mint #73D8B2 selected actions. All selected room chip and two-column Bedroom AC, Floor lamp, TV, Air sensor cards. Exactly three bottom tabs. Large text and contrast, no black glossy gradients.

screens.title: Compatibility
screens.description: Back Compatibility. Explanatory text Support is specific to platform, region and model. Fictional examples Example Home / Planned, Example TV / Pairing research, Example Climate / Authorization blocked. Mock devices / Preview only. Tap a row for evidence details. No fake verified badge or promised whole-brand support.

screens.title: Reorder device cards
screens.description: Back Reorder Devices, subtitle Living Room. Small two-column card grid with drag handles on Floor lamp and Living room TV; third Air sensor card. Floor lamp marked Pinned. A faint drag placement outline between cards. Primary Done. Helper Drag cards to change their order in this room. Clear visual feedback, no room membership change.

boards.title: The same home, with more space
boards.subtitle: Flutter tablet layouts preserve the same three destinations

screens.title: Tablet device home
screens.description: Wide HomeVerb tablet Devices page. A compact left navigation rail contains exactly Devices selected, Platforms, Settings. Main area header HomeVerb with Search and Add Device. Horizontal room chips All selected, Living Room, Primary Bedroom, Bathroom. Spacious three-column device cards Bedroom AC, Floor lamp, TV, Air sensor, Washer, Fridge. Status and separate power action targets. No fourth share tab, side dashboards or analytics.

screens.title: Tablet device controls
screens.description: Wide tablet with identical left three-item navigation rail, Devices selected. Main area split into a narrow local device list (Bedroom AC selected, Floor lamp, TV) and roomy Bedroom AC control panel with 24 C target minus/plus, Room 26 C, Power On, Mode Cool, Fan Auto, Refresh State and information button. Back to Devices in header. This is the same capability control flow adapted to width, not a different feature set.

boards.title: Clear even when information is missing
boards.subtitle: Cached snapshots, unknown readings, validation and larger text

screens.title: Cached device state
screens.description: HomeVerb root device page with All selected and exactly three bottom tabs Devices, Platforms, Settings. A subtle banner Saved state / Last read 4 hours ago with Refresh button. Bedroom AC card shows 24 C marked Cached; Floor lamp shows On marked Cached; Air sensor shows Unknown, not zero. Text Connection not checked. Do NOT label devices offline merely because state is old. Search and add remain available.

screens.title: Unknown sensor reading
screens.description: Back Air sensor, Living Room. Read-only screen with Temperature / Not available and Humidity / Not available. Use a dash as placeholder, not 0, 0% or Off. Small Previous read / Yesterday 20:14, Refresh State button. No power switch or writable sensor controls. Brief message No current reading. No bottom navigation.

screens.title: Invalid control value
screens.description: Back Bedroom AC, compact control page with observed target 24 C / Read just now. Bottom sheet Set Temperature with numeric field 23.5 C, red inline error Use whole degrees for this device. Save disabled, Cancel enabled. Helper Supported step: 1 C for this device. Requested invalid input does not replace observed 24 C. No universal temperature range, no bottom navigation.

screens.title: Larger text layout
screens.description: HomeVerb root device page with genuinely larger type and ONE-COLUMN stacked device cards instead of two columns. Room filters horizontally scroll, All selected. Visible cards Bedroom AC / Primary Bedroom / Cooling 24 C and Floor lamp / Living Room / On 65%, with generous power buttons. Freshness line Updated just now. Exactly three bottom nav labels Devices, Platforms, Settings. No clipped or overlapping text. Preserve content hierarchy and accessible touch targets.
